say:1:1341101001:1.text: Merlin, do you know any spells that could lower the temperature here even further?
say:1:1341101001:1.source_cn: 嚯，我说梅林，你有没有什么魔法能让这里的温度再降低一些？
say:1:1341101001:1.male: Merlin, do you know any spells that could lower the temperature here even further?
say:1:1341101001:1.female: Merlin, do you know any spells that could lower the temperature here even further?

choice_prompt:2:1341101001.male: Merlin, do you know any spells that could lower the temperature here even further?
choice_prompt:2:1341101001.female: Merlin, do you know any spells that could lower the temperature here even further?

say:3:1341101003:1.text: Remember why I'm here? I came to develop the low-temperature forging technology, but it isn't cold enough for the ores to undergo a phase change.
say:3:1341101003:1.source_cn: 你们还记得吧，我来雪松镇是要研究低温锻造技术的。可现在...

say:4:1341101004:1.text: I need a temperature low enough to freeze the air!
say:4:1341101004:1.source_cn: 必须是那种——能将空气都冻住的寒冷才行！

say:6:1341101005:1.text: Huh? But... humans can't survive in such an environment! You wouldn't be able to forge anything.
say:6:1341101005:1.source_cn: 啊？可是……那种温度人都没有办法生存！就算主人能把温度...
say:6:1341101005:1.male: Huh? But... humans can't survive in such an environment! You wouldn't be able to forge anything.
say:6:1341101005:1.female: Huh? But... humans can't survive in such an environment! You wouldn't be able to forge anything.

say:7:1341101006:1.text: Hmm, you've got a point. Let's see...
say:7:1341101006:1.source_cn: 哦嚯，这倒是个新的问题。让我想想……

say:8:1341101007:1.text: Hey, I have an idea! Merlin, as a miracle worker, you must have a way around this, right?
say:8:1341101007:1.source_cn: 嚯，我想到了！梅林，作为创造了诸多奇迹的大魔法师，你应...
say:8:1341101007:1.male: Hey, I have an idea! Merlin, as a miracle worker, you must have a way around this, right?
say:8:1341101007:1.female: Hey, I have an idea! Merlin, as a miracle worker, you must have a way around this, right?

choice_prompt:9:1341101007.text: Hey, I have an idea! Merlin, as a miracle worker, you must have a way around this, right?
choice_prompt:9:1341101007.source_cn: 嚯，我想到了！梅林，作为创造了诸多奇迹的大魔法师，你应该，不，你一定有办法的，对吧？！
choice_prompt:9:1341101007.male: Hey, I have an idea! Merlin, as a miracle worker, you must have a way around this, right?
choice_prompt:9:1341101007.female: Hey, I have an idea! Merlin, as a miracle worker, you must have a way around this, right?

say:10:1341101008:1.text: *Cough* So, can you help me or not?
say:10:1341101008:1.source_cn: 咳，那你到底有没有办法？
say:10:1341101008:1.male: *Cough* So, can you help me or not?
say:10:1341101008:1.female: *Cough* So, can you help me or not?

say:11:1341101010:1.text: How about using a different ore?
say:11:1341101010:1.source_cn: 如果不能再降低温度，能不能换一种矿石呢？

say:12:1341101011:1.text: Well, there aren't many alternatives—luminite is currently the only known ore that can stay cold on its own.
say:12:1341101011:1.source_cn: 很难，冰晶石是目前所知的唯一一种能够自行保持一定低温的...

choice_prompt:13:1341101011.text: Well, there aren't many alternatives—luminite is currently the only known ore that can stay cold on its own.
choice_prompt:13:1341101011.source_cn: 很难，冰晶石是目前所知的唯一一种能够自行保持一定低温的矿石了！

say:14:1341101012:1.text: Aha! I could probably attach something to Hardhead to prevent excess heat during forging...
say:14:1341101012:1.source_cn: 嚯！对啊，如果我给铁头加上一种装置，能让它在锻打的时候...

say:15:1341101013:1.text: That's worth a try! Let me work on the blueprint right away!
say:15:1341101013:1.source_cn: 没错……对！有点思路了，我得去画设计图了！

say:16:1341101014:1.text: Haha, I knew I could count on you!
say:16:1341101014:1.source_cn: 哈哈，我就知道梅林有办法的！
say:16:1341101014:1.male: Haha, I knew I could count on you!
say:16:1341101014:1.female: Haha, I knew I could count on you!

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 你想到的办法就是让我想办法？

say:18:1341101009:1.text: Sometimes, I gain inspiration from people in other fields!
say:18:1341101009:1.source_cn: 有时候就是需要一些其他行业人士的思维碰撞，才能激发我灵...

say:19:1341101002:0.text: Cold enough? Not even close! Hardhead can't perform his best at this temperature!
say:19:1341101002:0.source_cn: 冷？当然不够！铁头说了，这样的温度它可没法发挥最大的威力！

choice:2:1:2.text: Why do you need it colder?
choice:2:1:2.male: Why do you need it colder?
choice:2:1:2.female: Why do you need it colder?
